text:
Liam: Scheduling an RC cut for redwood-inference v2.3.1-rc6 at 04:00 UTC. Short window, prefer conservative canary. @Eva please run quick smoke at 03:40.
Eva: Ack. I'll run smoke and run the regression eval set. Posting results here.
deploybot: deploybot: candidate created: redwood-inference:v2.3.1-rc6 (sha:gh789). pin=candidate-rc6. Canary workflow queued.
Liam: Canary plan: 1% -> 10% (10m) -> 30% (15m) -> 100% if clean. Abort on quality regression (>2% top-1 delta on eval set) or errors >1%.
Eva: Smoke at 03:40: infra OK, basic flows pass. Running regression eval: will post numbers in ~5m.
Oncall: I'll watch SLOs, logs, and the model-quality alerts. I prepped a one-click rollback.
Oncall: ```
# one-click rollback job
ci trigger job/rollback/redwood-inference --to=v2.3.0 --reason="rc6-quality-fallback"
```
deploybot: deploybot: canary 1% promoted -> 10%. telemetry: p50=170ms, errors=0.2%.
Eva: Regression eval: top-1 match delta = 3.4% (rc6 worse) on our smoke prompt set, mostly for long-context summarization. Marking as hold.
Liam: Hold promotion. Do not proceed to 30%. QA/Product, can you confirm this is unacceptable for this release?
QA: Confirmed — user-visible regressions on summarization tests. Failing samples attached: https://internal/evals/rc6/gh789 
Product: This delta is a blocker; we can't ship with worse summarization. Recommend rollback and a hotfix.
Liam: Agreed. Abort promotion and rollback to last stable (v2.3.0).
deploybot: deploybot: promotion aborted by Liam. Initiating rollback to v2.3.0.
deploybot: deploybot: rollback complete. prod pinned to v2.3.0. release-notes: https://internal/release/2.3.0
Eva: I'll open a diagnostic PR to investigate quantization/config changes that landed in rc6 (link to PR forthcoming). Will run ablation to find the regression source.
Oncall: Monitoring for residual anomalies. If anything spikes, ping me in this thread.
Liam: Action items: Eva to PR a revert/hotfix branch, QA to re-run the full eval after fix, Product to reassess release cadence. We'll re-cut once the root cause is resolved. Thanks all.
